item.title: Why dining hall plates are beyond beautiful
item.description: A student is no different than a dining hall plate, Batts argues. Both are overspilling, busy serving others, then stacked at night to repeat the cycle again. The post Why dining hall plates are beyond beautiful appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Beyond Bars: Why the words still matter
item.description: In her column, Tina Li explores the importance of authenticity and lyricism in rap, reflecting on how truthful storytelling deepens listeners’ connection to music. The post Beyond Bars: Why the words still matter appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.description: Medical student Brian Zhang calls for more respect toward PAs in medical school and hospitals, reflecting on his training at Stanford. The post From the Community | The case for medical doctor-physician assistant student unity appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
